home.title: EPS: ticketing for every event organiser
home.lead: One platform, each organiser's own brand. This is the prototype foundation: sign-in, the status round trip and the pipeline.

signIn.title: Sign in to EPS
signIn.lead: Enter your email and we will send you a one-time sign-in link. It works once and expires after 15 minutes.
signIn.sent: If the address can receive links, a sign-in link is on its way to {email}.
signIn.demoLead: For the public demo: no email needed.
signIn.mailboxLead: No mail provider is set up, so links for {domain} addresses appear here instead of being sent.
signIn.mailboxEmpty: No links for this address yet.
signIn.linkInvalid: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Send yourself a new one.
signIn.sendFailed: We could not send a link to that address. Real addresses are disabled until a mail provider is configured; use a demo address or demo access.
signIn.demoFailed: Demo sign-in failed. Please try again in a minute.
